Bond fluctuations remain approximately5.5-6.3 times reference MD, versus1.6 times for released PVB. Scalar RMSF alone can conceal excessive internal distortion.
Nonbonded-distance path-score point estimates beat PVB but paired intervals cross zero. Increment-path scores are worse than PVB in both seeds, with positive paired intervals.
The immediate scientific target is to preserve local chemistry while learning coherent internal and rigid-body dynamics. Increasing motion amplitude without this separation is not a solution.
Pretrained geometry bridge and direct-physical-time training remain ongoing; their efficacy has not been measured. No new model variant was launched from this exploratory analysis.
